name: figma-bridge
description: Local MCP bridge that lets any AI agent design in the Figma desktop app, with no rate limits.

scripts.build: bun build plugin/code.ts --outfile plugin/code.js --target browser --format iife
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p plugin/tsconfig.json && bun run scripts/check-plugin.ts
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run test/selftest.ts
